findings_so_far: ANGLE 1 DETERMINISM — HOLDS, AND HARDER THAN CLAIMED. My own independently written probe reproduces all 40 of the builder's stored 8 s bed|tod digests EXACTLY: different tool, different process, different browser launch, different commit (0f6ff17 -> 444d43d), 18 minutes later, reverse capture order, loadavg 13-19 vs the builder's. 40/40 same, 0 diff.

AND UNDER THE CONDITIONS THE FENCE NEVER TESTS: 60 s captures (1-5 L3/L4 events per bed, vs 0 at 8 s), listener placed ON the emitter so R7 renders, both capture orders, four separate browser processes, loads 13.1-18.9. Every bed bit-identical in every arm.

BUT THE SHIPPED FENCE IS BLIND TO HALF OF R3. reports/w1-22/ambience-determinism.json records fired: 0 for ALL FORTY bed x tod rows -- the default --seconds 8 is shorter than every L3 interval band (min 8 s), and the tool hardcodes listener: null. So the '20 beds, 2 tod, 3 captures, bit-identical' headline is a claim about the continuous bed alone. The seeded event scheduler (R3's actual subject) and the R7 emitters -- the two things that put voices into the DeterministicMixer's ROTATING grain lanes -- are never exercised by the standing gate.

R5 FINDING: at 60 s, listener none, NIGHT IS BIT-IDENTICAL TO DAY for 9 of 13 regions (clay-moor, crimson-coast, deep-marshes, eastern-rootlands, hive, salt-hills, stone-wastes, thornmarsh, valus-ridge). Only blackwood, marauders-coast, stone-forest, western-rootlands differ.

SUCCESSOR-2 / AMENDMENT A: the three headline numbers REPRODUCE exactly off reports/w1-22/ambience-onsets.json (median bed-alone crest 12.25 vs claimed 12.3; median mix crest 16.05 vs 16.2; 3 of 40 clips >=20 dB). But the DERIVATION does not hold. It rests on 'a short grain carries 6-10 dB of its own peak-to-RMS'; measured from the same report over 419 events that quantity is 4.4-23.0 dB, median 10.94, p90 17.30, with 61.6% ABOVE 10 dB. At the p90 grain a clip reaches 20 dB crest with the event at +2.70 dB rel bed, INSIDE RI-AUD03 SectionA's band. Empirical counterexamples: thornmarsh reaches 19.1 dB crest with its loudest L3 at +0.01 rel bed, salt-hills 19.5 dB with +1.49. So 'the two clauses cannot both be satisfied' is FALSE as stated; it is true of the MEDIAN grain only.

SUCCESSOR-2 / AMENDMENT A, the harder half: the amendment says 'I am not proposing to widen SectionA's band, and I have not widened it' and calls what the build does 'in every case the conservative reading'. The build HAS widened it in fact. The Hive ships chitin_scrape at +10.23 and +10.61 dB rel bed -- 8.6 dB outside SectionA's L3 cap of +2 and exactly the '+10 dB' the amendment's own arithmetic predicts -- and that single event is the ONLY reason the Hive is the one bed clearing the judge's 20 dB bar (23.3 dB; drop it and the clip sits at 19.1). Gate O3 reports pass with ZERO failures because O3 grades the layer MEDIAN, which eleven quiet cell_ticks hold at -2.00.

SUCCESSOR-2 / IN-BAND-THEN-BURIED IS NOT FIXED, it is fixed AT THE MEDIAN. `event_gain_db` is one trim PER LAYER; `synth.gain_db` varies PER EVENT (-5..-13). A per-layer trim cannot unbury an event quieter than its layer-mates. Measured: 11 of 33 bed/layer pairs pass O3's median while containing an out-of-band event; between-event spread within a layer is median 10.82 dB over 11 multi-event layers, worst 17.48 dB. blackwood/distant_axe -- one of the three sounds the bed's OWN `brief` advertises -- renders at -18.8 dB rel bed, 12.8 dB below SectionA's L3 floor. Also well/stone_shift -16.3, dungeon/block_settle -11.1, western-rootlands/reed_snap -9.8.

SUCCESSOR-2 / DECLARED CHAIN vs RENDER: level_db + synth.gain_db + event_gain_db predicts the rendered rel_db with median error -1.09 dB but p90 |err| 14.96 dB and max 20.78 dB. The piece's own diagnosis ('loudness is not the sum of the numbers you typed') still holds after the fix, for individual events.

SUCCESSOR-2 / DETECTOR REFUSAL LOCATED: ambience-onsets.mjs:416 guards every subtraction with `if (!muteWorks.ok || muteWorks.muted !== 0) ... 'Refusing to report.' exit(2)`. It checks that the MUTED arm fired nothing; it NEVER checks that the UNMUTED arm fired anything. The shipped fixture is blackwood/4 s/8 kHz and the stored report records full:0, muted:0, ok:true -- BOTH ARMS EMPTY, because 4 s is shorter than the shortest L3 interval band (blackwood L3 interval_s [8,24]). The refusal is real code on a reachable branch but is unreachable for the reason it exists. Browser falsification pending in tools/audio/critic-w1-22-r2-probe.mjs P1.

SUCCESSOR-2 / AMENDMENT B VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY off the 13 shipped bed `key` fields: 7 distinct triples, 10 of 13 regions sharing one. Amendment B holds and RI-AUD03 SectionC's 'no duplicate triples except one group of four' is false. This is load-bearing for the pack design.
